passage.label: Al-Baqarah — Allah has taken no son; subhanahu; everything in heavens and earth belongs to Him; all are qanitoon; BadiAA of heavens and earth; kun fayakoon; ignorant demand direct speech or sign; hearts of past and present resemble each other; ayat made clear for people of yaqeen; Prophet sent with haqq as basheer and nadheer; not responsible for companions of jaheem; Jews and Christians will never be pleased until you follow their millah; hudaa Allah huwa al-hudaa; following their desires after knowledge leaves no waliyy or naseer; those given Kitab who recite it properly believe in it; disbelievers are losers; Bani Israel reminded of niAAmah and preference over worlds; fear Day when no soul suffices for another; no adl accepted; no shafaAAah benefits; no help

arabicExcerpts.text: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ لَوۡلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا ٱللَّهُ أَوۡ تَأۡتِينَآ ءَايَةٞۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡۘ تَشَٰبَهَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تُسۡـَٔلُ عَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

وَلَن تَرۡضَىٰ عَنكَ ٱلۡيَهُودُ وَلَا ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمۡۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰۗ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بَعۡدَ ٱلَّذِي جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَتۡلُونَهُۥ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِۦٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۗ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
وَٱتَّقُواْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا تَجۡزِي نَفۡسٌ عَن نَّفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٞ وَلَا تَنفَعُهَا شَفَٰعَةٞ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

mainSubject.label: Claim that Allah took a son refuted: subhanahu; rather to Him belongs whatever is in heavens and earth; all are qanitoon to Him; BadiAA of samawat and ard; when He decrees matter He says kun fayakoon; those who do not know ask why Allah does not speak to them or bring sign; same words spoken by those before them; their hearts resemble each other; ayat clarified for people of certainty; Prophet sent with truth as bearer of glad tidings and warner; not asked about companions of Hellfire; Jews and Christians will never be pleased until you follow their religion; guidance of Allah is the guidance; following their desires after knowledge means no protector or helper from Allah; those given Book who recite it with true recital believe in it; whoever disbelieves in it is loser; Bani Israel reminded of Allah's favor and preference over worlds; fear Day when no soul suffices for another, no compensation accepted, no intercession benefits, no help given
